subject.title: [Feature] Decouple dreaming from memory-core — allow any memory plugin to implement dreaming protocol

question: Should OpenClaw define a core memory dreaming provider protocol/scheduler contract, leave plugin-specific dreaming to ClawHub packages for now, or wait for the broader memory role-slot API first?
rationale: The remaining work changes public plugin API/config semantics and crosses memory-core, plugin loader, scheduler, docs, and third-party plugin boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Decide after role-slot review
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 to settle memory role taxonomy first, then keep this issue as the narrower dreaming-provider protocol follow-up if role slots land.

options.title: Accept a narrow dreaming protocol now
options.body: Sponsor a focused SDK/config proposal for query, promote, report-state, and scheduler ownership without waiting for the broader memory role-slot PR.

options.title: Keep dreaming plugin-specific
options.body: Route LanceDB and other backend-specific dreaming implementations to ClawHub packages unless a concrete missing core API remains after plugin authors prove the gap.

recommendation.title: Decide after role-slot review
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 to settle memory role taxonomy first, then keep this issue as the narrower dreaming-provider protocol follow-up if role slots land.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a durable product/API direction choice and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the top project decision owner.
